content.text: {"Id":"BUG-TRIAGE-124","Title":"Plugin cache version swap breaks mid-turn Codex hooks","Section":"Backlog","Priority":"high","Done":false,"Estimate":null,"Note":null,"Description":["Confirmed version-drift failure mode: a turn can start against an installed Codex plugin cache (e.g. 1.83.0) while that cache directory is replaced mid-turn so only a newer version remains (e.g. 1.85.0). Hooks such as code-verify keep resolving through the old absolute path and fail when the directory is gone. The signed marker can still declare the old plugin_version because marker generation prefers CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT/env roots over discovering the newest cache, and marker rewrite is not coupled to host cache replacement. Manually retargeting CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT and MCP_PLUGIN_ROOT to the new installed cache restores Status=available without recreating the session. SyncAgentPlugins refreshes versioned cache roots via ReplacePluginCache but does not keep in-flight hook paths, process env, and signed marker plugin_version atomically aligned during replacement.","Triage group: triage-group-6b77845a146f9082","Reports: 1"],"TechnicalDetails":["Acceptance criteria:","- After a plugin cache version is replaced while a Codex turn is open, required hooks (including code-verify) either continue to resolve a valid on-disk plugin root or fail with an explicit version-drift error that names the missing path and the available replacement version.","- A workspace marker regenerated after an installed cache upgrade reports agentPlugins.Codex.plugin_version equal to the active installed cache version when CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT is unset or points at a missing path.","- Setting only CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT/MCP_PLUGIN_ROOT to the new cache is not required for Status=available after a normal upgrade once the workspace is re-validated; automatic root resolution finds the newest installed cache.","- An in-flight turn that opened against version N does not permanently lose its plugin root solely because version N\u002B1 was installed; either N remains until the turn ends or the runtime switches to N\u002B1 without path-not-found failures.","Implementation notes:","- Primary race is host cache lifecycle vs sticky absolute hook/env roots, not session-log state. Focus on cache retention, atomic env/marker refresh, or path rebinding.","- build/Build.SyncAgentPlugins.cs RefreshKnownPluginCaches/ReplacePluginCache writes the new versioned cache root; coordinate any cleanup of prior version directories so active processes are not invalidated, or keep the previous version until no open turn references it.","- MarkerFileService.ResolveAgentPluginVersion prefers environment roots first; if CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT points at a deleted version directory, signed markers can lag. Prefer falling through to EnumerateUserPluginCacheRoots when the env root is missing, and rewrite markers after successful cache refresh.","- Plugin runtime (plugin-env.ps1, resolve-cache-dir.ps1, hook wrappers) should re-resolve MCP_PLUGIN_ROOT/CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT when the configured root no longer exists, selecting the highest installed cache under ~/.codex/plugins/cache for mcpserver-codex-plugin.","- Add a regression test covering: turn starts on cache version A, A is removed and B installed, code-verify/status still succeeds or reports a controlled drift diagnostic without requiring manual env surgery."],"ImplementationTasks":null,"CompletedDate":null,"DoneSummary":null,"Remaining":null,"PriorityNote":null,"Reference":null,"Phase":null,"DependsOn":null,"FunctionalRequirements":["FR-MCP-TRIAGE-002"],"TechnicalRequirements":["TR-MCP-TRIAGE-004"],"IdempotencyKey":null}
